meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 让 Claude 接手 Git 操作:按仓库现有风格把改动拆成原子提交、执行 rebase 或 squash,也能用 log、blame、bisect、reflog 查历史问题。写入前先读仓库状态,没明确要求不动历史。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史(谁改的、哪次改的、何时改的)时接管;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按模块拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先读 diff 分组,再按路径暂存提交

say.text: 用 blame 查这个文件第 20 到 40 行是谁改的
say.note: 回答会附 commit 哈希、标题和行号

say.text: 把这两个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 重写前会先确认分支与上游状态

howto.what_en: Takes over Git work: splits changes into atomic commits, runs rebase or squash, and answers history questions with log, blame, bisect, or reflog. It reads repo state first and won't rewrite history unless you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a Git-history investigation (who, when, or which commit changed something); ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few atomic commits by module
say_en.note: reads the diff, groups, then stages by path

say_en.text: Use blame to find who last changed lines 20-40 of this file
say_en.note: answers with commit hash, subject and line

say_en.text: Squash these two commits into one
say_en.note: checks branch and upstream status before rewriting
